additional_info.subject: MP/P4170000467 – Recurring Fault on Connector 1 at Mitzpe Ramon Site
additional_info.body:
Hello Siemens Support,
We would like to report a recurring issue on our main charging station located in
Mitzpe Ramon
.
This charger is a major and critical unit in our network, and the problem is causing repeated charging failures.
Issue Description:
Connector 1 shows as
Available
, but immediately after plugging the connector into the vehicle, it switches to
Faulted
and becomes unresponsive.
This happens in almost every charging attempt.
From the backend logs, we consistently see:
Status: FAULTED
Error Code: [OTHER_ERROR]
Vendor Error Code: secc pilot is E / evse is not ready
We have already performed basic troubleshooting steps, including a full power cycle, but the issue persists.
Charger Details:
Serial Number:
MP/P4170000467
Model:
Sicharge D4 CCS + AC
Location:
Delek Mitzpe Ramon, Israel
Affected Connector:
CCS2 – Connector 1
This station is heavily used and highly important to our operations, so your urgent assistance will be greatly appreciated.
We can provide logs, photos, or any additional information upon request.
Thank you,
Ahmad
ZEN ENERGY
​
​
​
​
Ahmed Haim
Electrician
*5619
|
ahmedh@zen-ev.com
